2110751184713646146.en_summary: @jonnajarian asks what one would do after chasing 105,000 November 115 calls in $WMT bought Oct 6 at $1.52; those calls opened at $5.00 today for a $3.48 profit, so a 20-lot ($3,040) became about $6,960 profit, over 200%.
2110751184713646146.zh_summary: @jonnajarian 問：若追買 10 月 6 日以 1.52 美元買入的 105,000 張 $WMT 11 月 115 買權，今日該選擇權開盤 5.00 美元、獲利 3.48 美元，以 20 口（成本約 3,040 美元）計獲利約 6,960 美元，逾 200%。
2110751184713646146.ko_summary: @jonnajarian은 10/6 $1.52에 산 $WMT 11월 115 콜 10.5만 계약을 추격했다면, 오늘 콜이 $5.00 개장해 $3.48 이익이라 20롯($3,040)이 약 $6,960 이익(200%+)이라고 했다.

2110751251139023166.en_summary: @PeterLBrandt says Factor LLC closed its last long in silver futures last January and has bought $PSLV the past two days for retirement/pension-type capital; they will buy more if silver hits $47.
2110751251139023166.zh_summary: @PeterLBrandt 表示其交易公司 Factor LLC 去年 1 月平掉白銀期貨最後多單，近兩日為退休／養老型資金買入 $PSLV；若白銀觸及 47 美元將再買。
2110751251139023166.ko_summary: @PeterLBrandt는 Factor LLC가 지난 1월 은 선물 마지막 롱을 청산했고, 퇴직/연금형 자본으로 이틀간 $PSLV를 샀으며 은이 $47이면 더 산다고 했다.

2110751446257848444.en_summary: @KobeissiLetter says on October 2, as the 10Y yield hit 5.30%, they turned bullish on $TLT and called for $80.00+ this month for premium members; today those longs are up sharply and nearing the target.

2110751802606190704.en_summary: @sentimentrader notes $SPX is still near its highs while semiconductor sentiment tells a different story: on Oct. 14 $SMH sentiment plunged to 10.57 (extreme pessimism) while $VXX sentiment climbed to 73.36, pointing to risk concerns beneath the index.
2110751802606190704.zh_summary: @sentimentrader 指出 $SPX 仍接近高位，但半導體情緒不同：10 月 14 日 $SMH 情緒跌至 10.57（極端悲觀），$VXX 情緒升至 73.36，顯示指數表面下風險擔憂上升。
2110751802606190704.ko_summary: @sentimentrader는 $SPX가 고점 근처인데 반도체 심리는 다르다고 했다. 10/14 $SMH 심리 10.57(극단 비관), $VXX 심리 73.36으로 지수 아래 리스크 우려를 시사한다고 했다.
